metadata.name: ww-rich-text-v2
metadata.description: Rich text editor (Tiptap) for writing formatted content, with HTML or Markdown output, mentions, tables, images, an AI rewrite menu, live SEO analysis, headings outline, and real-time collaboration with version history. This is for editing rich text, not only rendering it.
features: HTML or Markdown output exposed in the `value` variable, usable as a form field
Default toolbar with per-button flags, a custom toolbar slot, or no toolbar
Optional header slot scrolling with the text above a sticky toolbar
Tables with row/column handles, drag and drop, resizing and a right-click menu
Images and link popovers renderable with custom templates (local context)
AI menu: the workflow receives the prompt and sends the answer back
Live SEO analysis with scores, checks and in-text highlighting
Headings outline with visible-section tracking and scroll actions
Real-time collaboration (Yjs/Hocuspocus) with cursors, saves and version history compare
Read-only mode to display rich text
Custom empty state (your own elements) while the document is empty, with an isEmpty variable

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Read-only mode: content is displayed, the toolbar is hidden and editing is disabled. Adds the `readonly` element state.

properties.name: showHeader
properties.description: Show a header container (the `headerElement` slot) above the toolbar. Header, toolbar and text then scroll together inside the element, which needs a fixed height; the toolbar sticks to the top once the header has scrolled away.

properties.name: headerAlignText
properties.description: Give the header the width and horizontal position of the text column (editorPadding and editorMaxWidth). False = full-width header. Inactive when showHeader is false.

properties.name: customMenu
properties.description: Replace the default toolbar with the `customMenuElement` slot, to build a fully custom toolbar driven by the element actions and the `states` variable.

properties.name: menuPosition
properties.description: 'top' (default): the toolbar sticks to the top of the text. 'bottom': it sticks to the bottom of the editor, within thumb reach; bind it to the breakpoint (bottom on mobile and tablet).

properties.name: centerMenu
properties.description: Center the toolbar on the text column at its own width (it may be wider than the column, never wider than the element).

properties.name: initialValue
properties.description: Initial content (HTML or Markdown string, not multilang). Feeds the `value` variable; changing it later emits `initValueChange`. Inactive when enableCollaboration is true (the content then comes from the collaboration server).

properties.name: output
properties.description: Format of the `value` variable and of event payloads. Values: "html" | "markdown".

properties.name: debounce
properties.description: Debounce the `change` event (and the `value` update). Use it when the change workflow does expensive work (API calls, autosave).

properties.name: debounceDelay
properties.description: Debounce delay as a CSS-like duration string between 1ms and 5000ms (e.g. "500ms"). Inactive when debounce is false.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder shown when the editor is empty (plain string, not multilang).

properties.name: useEmptyLayout
properties.description: Shows the emptyLayoutElement container (any elements: illustration, text, buttons) centred over the text while the document is empty (a single empty paragraph; the frontmatter is ignored). The native placeholder is hidden meanwhile. In collaboration it waits for the first sync, so it never flashes before the content arrives. Clicking outside a button, link or field inside it puts the cursor in the text. Hidden during a version preview.

properties.name: forceEmptyLayoutDisplay
properties.description: WeWeb editor only: always shows the empty state, even over text, to build it. No effect on the published app. Inactive when useEmptyLayout is false.

properties.name: enableOutline
properties.description: Track headings: fills the `outline` and `currentHeading` variables, emits `heading:change` and enables the scroll-to-heading actions. Read-only computation: nothing is written into the document.

properties.name: outlineLevels
properties.description: Heading levels kept in the outline: "h2", "h2h3", "h1h2h3" or "all". Inactive when enableOutline is false.

properties.name: outlineOffset
properties.description: Offset in px of the detection line: a heading becomes the visible section once it passes above it, and scroll-to-heading lands it there. Increase it when a fixed header covers the top of the text. Inactive when enableOutline is false.

properties.name: outlineIndicator
properties.description: Show a built-in breadcrumb (H2 › H3) of the visible section pinned above the text. Leave false to build your own UI from `currentHeading`. Inactive when enableOutline is false.

properties.name: outlineIndicatorColor
properties.description: Text color of the built-in outline breadcrumb. Inactive when enableOutline or outlineIndicator is false.

properties.name: outlineIndicatorBgColor
properties.description: Background color of the built-in outline breadcrumb. Inactive when enableOutline or outlineIndicator is false.

properties.name: enableSeoAnalysis
properties.description: Enable the live SEO analysis: fills the `seo` variable (global score, category scores, detailed checks), emits `seo:change` and enables the SEO highlight actions. No visual output by itself.

properties.name: seoKeyword
properties.description: Focus keyword the content should rank for (one per page). Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoKeywordSynonyms
properties.description: Close variants of the focus keyword, counted as equivalent in every check. Array of strings or comma-separated string. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoKeywordMatching
properties.description: How the focus keyword (and its synonyms) is found. How it is found in the text: "exact" (the phrase as written), "stopWords" (same order, small words like "de", "la" ignored) or "anyOrder" (all words in one sentence, any order). Case, accents and plurals are always tolerated.

properties.name: seoSecondaryKeywords
properties.description: Related keywords scored separately from the focus keyword. Array of strings or comma-separated string. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoSecondaryKeywordsMatching
properties.description: How each secondary keyword is found. How it is found in the text: "exact" (the phrase as written), "stopWords" (same order, small words like "de", "la" ignored) or "anyOrder" (all words in one sentence, any order). Case, accents and plurals are always tolerated.

properties.name: seoMetaTitle
properties.description: Page meta title, scored only when provided. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoMetaDescription
properties.description: Page meta description, scored only when provided. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoSiteDomain
properties.description: Site domain or full URL (e.g. "example.com") used to tell internal links from external ones. Also used outside the SEO analysis: internal links render as plain links, external ones get target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow".

properties.name: seoLang
properties.description: Language of the analyzed content (thresholds, readability formula, word lists). Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false. Values: "en" | "fr".

properties.name: seoUiLang
properties.description: Language of the check titles, descriptions and messages; "auto" follows seoLang. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false. Values: "auto" | "en" | "fr".

properties.name: seoHighlightColor
properties.description: Default CSS color of the highlightSeoCheck action (its Color argument overrides it). Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoExpectH1
properties.description: Set to true when the H1 is written inside the editor; false when the page provides it. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: seoWordLists
properties.description: Overrides the default fr/en word lists: { stopWords, genericAnchors, powerWords, sentimentWords, transitionWords, complexWords }, each an array of strings. Inactive when enableSeoAnalysis is false.

properties.name: enableGeoAnalysis
properties.description: Enables the GEO analysis (citability by AI engines): exposes the `geo` variable, same shape as `seo` plus `passages`, and the geo:change event. Shares keyword, language and word lists with the SEO analysis.

properties.name: geoQuestions
properties.description: Questions the content should answer (People Also Ask, tracked prompts), scored by the questionCoverage check. Array of strings or comma-separated string.

properties.name: geoEvergreen
properties.description: Evergreen content: the freshness check (recent years cited) does not apply.

properties.name: geoWordLists
properties.description: Overrides the default fr/en GEO word lists: { attributionWords, vagueWords, anaphoraOpeners, backReferences, genericHeadings, procedureWords, comparisonWords, definitionVerbs, questionWords, knownAcronyms, experienceMarkers, takeawayMarkers }, each an array of strings.

properties.name: showFrontmatter
properties.description: Shows the frontmatter fields (meta title, description, slug) at the top of the editor. Hidden, they stay readable through the `frontmatter` variable and editable with setFrontmatterField.

properties.name: frontmatterLabels
properties.description: Placeholder of each frontmatter field: [{ key: "meta_title", label: "Meta title" }]. Defaults: Meta title, Meta description, Slug.

properties.name: editorPadding
properties.description: Padding around the text: { paddingTop, paddingRight, paddingBottom, paddingLeft } as CSS lengths.

properties.name: editorMaxWidth
properties.description: Maximum width of the text column, centered inside the element (CSS length, "none" = full width).

properties.name: enableMention
properties.description: Enable mentions: typing mentionChar opens a suggestion list built from mentionList.

properties.name: mentionList
properties.description: Array of objects used as mention suggestions (typically bound to a collection). Inactive when enableMention is false.

properties.name: mentionIdPath
properties.description: Path, inside each mentionList item, to the unique id of the mention. Shown only when mentionList is bound and its items are objects. Inactive when enableMention is false.

properties.name: mentionLabelPath
properties.description: Path, inside each mentionList item, to the displayed label. Shown only when mentionList is bound and its items are objects. Inactive when enableMention is false.

properties.name: mentionAllowSpaces
properties.description: Allow spaces inside a mention query. Inactive when enableMention is false.

properties.name: mentionChar
properties.description: Character that triggers the mention suggestions. Inactive when enableMention is false.

properties.name: mentionListLength
properties.description: Maximum number of suggestions shown. Inactive when enableMention is false.

properties.name: autofocus
properties.description: Focus the editor automatically on mount.

properties.name: useImageLayout
properties.description: Render every image of the content with the `imageLayoutElement` slot instead of the default ; the template reads the image data from the `image` local context.

properties.name: useLinkLayoutPopover
properties.description: Render the link popover (shown when the cursor is on a link) with the `linkPopoverLayoutElement` slot instead of the default popover; the template reads the link data and callbacks from the `link` local context.

properties.name: linkEditing
properties.description: How a link is edited: 'popover' (default, floating popover) or 'inline'.

properties.name: forceLinkPopoverDisplay
properties.description: Keep the link popover visible instead of hiding it when the cursor leaves the link. Useful to design the custom popover.

properties.name: editable
properties.description: Whether the content can be edited. Unlike readonly, keeps the regular editor look.

properties.name: enableSpellcheck
properties.description: Enable the browser spellcheck inside the editor.

properties.name: hideMenu
properties.description: Hide the default toolbar entirely. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: wrapMenu
properties.description: Let the default toolbar wrap onto several lines instead of scrolling horizontally. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: menuColor
properties.description: Color of the default toolbar icons. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: h1
properties.description: Styling of h1 headings inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: h2
properties.description: Styling of h2 headings inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: h3
properties.description: Styling of h3 headings inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: h4
properties.description: Styling of h4 headings inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: h5
properties.description: Styling of h5 headings inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: h6
properties.description: Styling of h6 headings inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: p
properties.description: Styling of paragraphs inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, color, lineHeight, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: mention
properties.description: Styling of mentions inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, color, borderSize, borderRadius. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: a
properties.description: Styling of links inside the editor: fontSize, fontFamily, color, isUnderline, plus enableSafeLinks and the tooltip shown on links (tooltipColor, tooltipBackgroundColor, tooltipFontSize, tooltipText with {keyboard} and {target} placeholders). Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: blockquote
properties.description: Styling of blockquotes inside the editor: color, borderColor, marginTop, marginBottom. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Styling of code blocks inside the editor: color, bgColor, borderRadius, paddingX, paddingY, fontSize. Values are CSS strings; an empty string keeps the inherited style.

properties.name: img
properties.description: Styling of images inside the editor: maxWidth, maxHeight (CSS strings) and inline (boolean, images flow inline with text).

properties.name: checkbox
properties.description: Styling of task-list checkboxes inside the editor: color (accent color).

properties.name: table
properties.description: Styling of tables inside the editor: borderColor, borderWidth, headerBgColor, headerColor, pairCellBgColor, oddCellBgColor, cellColor, cellPaddingX, cellPaddingY, handleColor (row/column handles and resize handle).

properties.name: parameterTextType
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the paragraph/heading type selector button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterBold
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the bold button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterItalic
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the italic button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterUnderline
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the underline button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterStrike
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the strikethrough button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterAlignLeft
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the align-left button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterAlignCenter
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the align-center button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterAlignRight
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the align-right button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterAlignJustify
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the justify button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterTextColor
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the text color button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterBulletList
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the bullet list button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterOrderedList
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the ordered list button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterTaskList
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the task list (checkboxes) button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterTable
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the insert table button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterTableTools
properties.description: Table hover handles (select and drag rows/columns), column resizing and right-click menu (insert, delete, header row/column). Edition only: ignored when readonly.

properties.name: parameterLink
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the link button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterImage
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the image button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterCodeBlock
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the code block button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterQuote
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the blockquote button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterUndo
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the undo button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterRedo
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the redo button in the default toolbar. Inactive when customMenu is true.

properties.name: parameterAiMenu
properties.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the AI menu button in the toolbar. Inactive when enableAiMenu is false.

properties.name: enableAiMenu
properties.description: Enable the AI menu: the user picks a modification type, writes instructions, the element emits `ai-prompt`, and the workflow sends the AI answer back with the setResponse action. No AI call is made by the element itself.

properties.name: parameterAiMenuVariant
properties.description: AI menu style: "classic" (dropdown menu) or "magic" (inline prompt bar). Inactive when enableAiMenu is false.

properties.name: parameterAiMenuReadOnly
properties.description: Switch the text to read-only while the AI request is processing. Inactive when enableAiMenu is false.

properties.name: parameterAiMenuForceDisplay
properties.description: Keep the classic AI menu open inside the WeWeb editor (design helper). Inactive when enableAiMenu is false or the variant is "magic".

properties.name: parameterAiMenuPrimaryColor
properties.description: Primary color of the AI menu. Inactive when enableAiMenu is false.

properties.name: parameterMagicMenuButtonColor
properties.description: Color of the magic menu submit button (empty = primary color). Only used when enableAiMenu is true and parameterAiMenuVariant is "magic".

properties.name: parameterMagicMenuShowTypeLabel
properties.description: Display the modification type label in the magic menu badge. Only used when enableAiMenu is true and parameterAiMenuVariant is "magic".

properties.name: parameterMagicMenuDefaultTypeIndex
properties.description: Index, in parameterAiMenuCustomTypes, of the type selected by default. Only used when enableAiMenu is true and parameterAiMenuVariant is "magic".

properties.name: parameterMagicMenuShowTypesOnFocus
properties.description: When the type list opens on focus: "yes", "no-type-selected" (only when no type is selected) or "no". Only used when enableAiMenu is true and parameterAiMenuVariant is "magic".

properties.name: parameterAiMenuCustomTypes
properties.description: Modification types offered in the AI menu (none by default besides the sample). Each item: { key (unique id, sent as modificationType), label, icon (ww-icon object), promptPlaceholder, defaultPrompt, action ("replace" | "replace-all" | "insert-before" | "insert-after" | "append" | "prepend"), requireInput (boolean) }. Inactive when enableAiMenu is false.

defaultValue.label: Rephrase
defaultValue.defaultPrompt: Reformule ce texte avec un style différent tout en gardant le même sens

properties.name: parameterAiMenuPlaceholders
properties.description: Texts of the AI menu UI: { promptInput, processing, submitButton, cancelButton, promptInputTooltip, submitButtonTooltip, cancelButtonTooltip, chooseTypePlaceholder }. Each value is a plain string or a formula (for multilang). Inactive when enableAiMenu is false.

defaultValue.promptInputTooltip: Enter your instructions for the AI

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: Field name in the submitted payload when the element is inside a ww-form-container. Inactive outside a form container.

properties.name: customValidation
properties.description: Enable the custom validation formula. Inactive outside a form container.

properties.name: validation
properties.description: Custom validation formula: the field is valid when it evaluates to a truthy value. Inactive outside a form container or when customValidation is false.

properties.name: enableCollaboration
properties.description: Enable real-time collaboration (Yjs over a Hocuspocus WebSocket server): shared document, remote cursors, save signals and version history. The content then comes from the server, not from initialValue.

properties.name: websocketUrl
properties.description: WebSocket URL of the Hocuspocus collaboration server. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: documentId
properties.description: Identifier of the shared document on the server. Changing it switches document. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: authToken
properties.description: Token sent to the collaboration server for authentication. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: userName
properties.description: Name shown to the other users next to this user's cursor. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: userId
properties.description: Stable identifier used to attribute each written character in version history (falls back to userName when empty). Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: userColor
properties.description: Color (#rrggbb) of this user's cursor and selection, seen by everyone: give the color of their avatar. Empty: derived from their id.

properties.name: showMousePresence
properties.description: Shows each collaborator's mouse pointer over the text with their name and color, and shares yours.

properties.name: collabProtocol
properties.description: Collaboration server protocol: 'brispr' (default, versions) or 'template' (saving and server states through channels: collaborationStatus.channels and collab:channels-update; server writes shown live; no versions; saveDocument asks the server to save now).

properties.name: showVersionHistory
properties.description: Bind to a variable: true opens the version timeline (it replaces the toolbar), false returns to normal editing. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: showVersionTimeline
properties.description: Shows the version timeline while the history is open.

properties.name: versionDiffColorMode
properties.description: Highlight of added/removed content in version compare: "default" (green added / red removed) or "author" (each author's color). Hovering shows the author in both modes. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: versionDiffRail
properties.description: Show a thin rail along the right edge of the text during a version compare, one marker per change; clicking a marker scrolls to it. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: timelineContainerSelector
properties.description: CSS selector of a container of the page where the version timeline is rendered instead of the internal slot. Combine with the `isVersionPreview` variable to hide your own toolbar items during history. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: timelineSelectedColor
properties.description: Color of the selected bar in the version timeline. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: epochLoadButtonText
properties.description: Label of the button that loads an archived epoch in the version timeline. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: versionDiffAuthors
properties.description: Object mapping user ids to display names ({ userId: name }), used in the version compare tooltip and in the versions/contributors variables (falls back to the raw id). Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: autoConnect
properties.description: Connect to the collaboration server automatically on mount. When false, call the connectCollaboration action. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: saveMode
properties.description: When the server persists the document: "on-change", "on-unload", "auto-unload" (both) or "manual" (only through the saveDocument action). Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: saveDebounce
properties.description: Debounce in ms of the save signal sent to the server. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: agentColor
properties.description: Color of Brispr, the AI agent that writes into the document through the collaboration server: caret, freshly written text, users list and version diffs. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: agentIcon
properties.description: Design-system icon shown next to Brispr's name above its caret (empty = no icon). Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: agentWritingSpeed
properties.description: Speed, in words per second, at which Brispr's text is revealed. Speeds up when more than 10 s behind and once Brispr is done. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: agentFollow
properties.description: Scroll to keep Brispr's caret around the middle of the screen while it writes: "always", "readonly" (only when the editor is read-only) or "never". Paused while the user scrolls. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: agentLingerDelay
properties.description: Seconds Brispr stays in the users list (collaborationStatus.users, collab:awareness-update) after its text has finished revealing. Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

properties.name: agentRevealMode
properties.description: How the text the agent writes appears: 'auto' (a big change at once, tinted with the agent color; a small one word by word), 'block' or 'words'. Waits for a follow scroll to end.

properties.name: maxConnectionAttempts
properties.description: Maximum number of connection attempts before giving up (collab:error). Inactive when enableCollaboration is false.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Applied while the editor is read-only (readonly property).

events.name: change
events.description: Content changed (debounced when debounce is true).

payload.value: string (HTML or Markdown depending on output)

events.name: initValueChange
events.description: The bound initialValue changed.

events.name: mention:click
events.description: A rendered mention was clicked.

events.name: focus
events.description: The editor received focus.

events.name: blur
events.description: The editor lost focus.

events.name: seo:change
events.description: SEO score or grade changed (also emitted on the first analysis). Requires enableSeoAnalysis.

payload.scores: object: score 0-100 (or null) per category: structure, headings, readability, links, images, keyword, meta

events.name: heading:change
events.description: The visible section changed while scrolling (or the current heading was renamed). Empty values when no section is visible. Requires enableOutline.

payload.path: array of { id, level, text }: ancestors then the heading itself

events.name: ai-prompt
events.description: The user submitted a prompt in the AI menu. Call the AI in the workflow, then send the answer back with the setResponse action.

payload.modificationType: string: key of the selected custom type
payload.action: string: how the answer will be applied
payload.htmlValue: string: whole document at submit time

events.name: ai-suggestion-applied
events.description: The user accepted the AI suggestion and it was applied to the document.

events.name: collab:connected
events.description: Connected to the collaboration server.

events.name: collab:disconnected
events.description: Disconnected from the collaboration server.

events.name: collab:synced
events.description: The local document is in sync with the server.

events.name: collab:syncing
events.description: The document is syncing with the server.

events.name: collab:error
events.description: A collaboration error occurred (connection, auth, max attempts reached).

events.name: collab:awareness-update
events.description: The list of connected users changed.

events.name: collab:saving
events.description: The server started saving the document.

events.name: collab:saved
events.description: The server saved the document.

events.name: collab:version-created
events.description: Answer of the server to the createVersion action.

events.name: collab:content-replaced
events.description: The server replaced the whole document content (e.g. restore).

events.name: collab:stale-epoch
events.description: The local state belonged to an older epoch of the document and was reset from the server.

events.name: collab:agent-writing
events.description: Brispr (the AI agent) started writing into the document.

events.name: collab:agent-done
events.description: Brispr finished writing and its text has finished revealing.

events.name: version-history:select
events.description: A version was selected in the version timeline.

events.name: image:added
events.description: An image was added to the content.

events.name: image:updated
events.description: An image of the content was updated.

events.name: image:removed
events.description: An image was removed from the content.

events.name: link:opened
events.description: A link was opened from the link popover.

events.name: link:edited
events.description: A link URL was edited.

events.name: link:removed
events.description: A link was removed.

events.name: geo:change
events.description: GEO score changed.

events.name: collab:channels-update
events.description: Template server: a channel changed (save state, lock…).

events.name: collab:follow-change
events.description: The followed user changed (empty when following stops).

localContext.name: image
localContext.description: Available inside the imageLayoutElement slot (useImageLayout true), once per image: { imageId, url, alt, title, position, refresh, caption }.

localContext.name: link
localContext.description: Available inside the linkPopoverLayoutElement slot (useLinkLayoutPopover true): { url, truncatedUrl, modifierKey, openLink(), editLink(newUrl), removeLink(), closePopover() }.

actions.label: Focus Rich text
actions.description: Focus the editor.

actions.label: Set Link
actions.description: Wrap the current selection in a link.

actions.label: Set Image
actions.description: Insert an image at the cursor.

actions.label: Set Tag

variables.name: value
variables.description: Current content (HTML or Markdown depending on output). Bind to it directly instead of mirroring it in a variable.

variables.name: isEmpty
variables.description: true while the document body is empty (a single empty paragraph, frontmatter ignored). In collaboration, false until the first sync.

variables.name: mentions
variables.description: Mentions present in the content: array of { id, label }.

variables.name: states
variables.description: Selection state, to drive a custom toolbar: { selected: { text, wordCount, charCount }, textType ("p", "h1"…"h6"), textColor, bold, italic, underline, strike, bulletList, orderedList, checkList, link, codeBlock, blockquote, textAlign ("left" | "center" | "right" | "justify" | false), table }. selected values are empty/0 when the selection is collapsed.

variables.name: history
variables.description: { canUndo, canRedo } booleans, to enable custom undo/redo buttons.

variables.name: pendingChangesCount
variables.description: Number of ProseMirror steps accumulated since the last getAndClearChanges or clearChanges call.

variables.name: outline
variables.description: Table of contents (requires enableOutline): array of { id (slug, suffixed -2, -3 on duplicates, changes when renamed), index, level, text, parentId (closest higher-level heading), active (true on the visible section) }. Empty headings are ignored.

variables.name: currentHeading
variables.description: Visible section (requires enableOutline): { id, index, level, text, path: [{ id, level, text }] } where path is the breadcrumb (ancestors then the heading). null above the first heading.

variables.name: seo
variables.description: SEO analysis (requires enableSeoAnalysis, null otherwise): { score (0-100), grade ("green" | "orange" | "red", capped to orange by a failed critical check), criticalIssues (check ids), highlighting (boolean), scores: { structure, headings, readability, links, images, keyword, meta }, categories: [{ id, name, description, score, grade }], checks: [{ id, title, description, objective, category, status ("good" | "warning" | "bad" | "na"), score, weight, value, target, matchCount, clickable, message }], stats: { wordCount, charCount, sentenceCount, paragraphCount, headings, lists, tables, images, imagesWithoutAlt, internalLinks, externalLinks, keywordOccurrences, keywordDensity, fleschScore, readingTimeMinutes } }.

variables.name: geo
variables.description: GEO analysis (citability by AI engines), same shape as `seo` plus `passages`; null while enableGeoAnalysis is false.

variables.name: frontmatter
variables.description: Frontmatter fields of the document (meta_title, meta_description, slug…), as an object.

variables.name: collaborationStatus
variables.description: Collaboration state: { connected, synced, syncing, saving, saved, error, connectionId, users: [{ name, color, id }], userCount, agentWriting }.

variables.name: isVersionPreview
variables.description: True while a version preview or compare is shown (the editor is then read-only on a past state), false during normal editing.

variables.name: currentVersion
variables.description: Version selected in the timeline or compared, null outside history: { id, versionNumber, epoch, source, label, createdAt, createdBy, createdByName, status, publication: { status, error, contentVerified, updatedAt } | null, inserted, deleted, authors: [{ user, name, inserted, deleted }] }.

variables.name: versions
variables.description: Versions of the document, newest first, same shape as currentVersion. Loaded once synced and refreshed when a version is created or published.

variables.name: contributors
variables.description: Everyone who modified the document across versions: [{ user, name, inserted, deleted, versions, lastModifiedAt }]. Names resolved through versionDiffAuthors.

specifications: Bind to the `value` variable to read the content; never mirror it in a separate variable with a change workflow. Inside a repeat, store the value from the change event instead.
Default output is HTML; set output to "markdown" to get Markdown. Markdown does not keep table column widths.
When showHeader is true, give the element a fixed height: header, toolbar and text scroll inside it.
Toolbar buttons are controlled one by one with the parameter* flags; hideMenu hides the toolbar; customMenu replaces it with the customMenuElement slot.
Table handles, the right-click menu and resizing only work while editing (not readonly, not inside the WeWeb editor).
The AI menu does not call any AI service: handle the ai-prompt event in a workflow, call the AI, then call setResponse with the answer.
With enableCollaboration, the content comes from the collaboration server: initialValue is ignored and websocketUrl plus documentId are required.
SEO analysis, outline and collaboration are opt-in (enableSeoAnalysis, enableOutline, enableCollaboration); their variables stay empty/null while disabled.
Outline and SEO only read the content: they never write ids or attributes into the document.
Inside a ww-form-container, set a unique fieldName so the submitted payload includes this field.
useEmptyLayout replaces the plain placeholder with your own elements (emptyLayoutElement); bind other elements to the `isEmpty` variable rather than computing emptiness from `value`.
